title: Battlegrounds Mobile India
format: Custom-room battle royale, 3-4 maps (Erangel/Miramar/Sanhok), up to 16 squads per lobby; groups -> semis -> final when >16 squads
igIdHint: Numeric ID under your name in Profile (usually 9-10 digits). Length range unverified - allow 9-12.

extraFields.label: In-game name
extraFields.hint: Exactly as shown in kill feed

rules: 4 players + max 1 sub; sub may swap only between maps
Phone only - no emulators, no iPads unless the event says so
Room ID/password shared 10-15 min before start; match starts on time
Captain uploads end-of-match Results screen within 15 min
Teaming, hacks, GFX/file mods = DQ + platform ban
Tiebreak: WWCDs > placement points > finishes > last-match rank
scoring: BGIS standard: placement 1st 10, 2nd 6, 3rd 5, 4th 4, 5th 3, 6th 2, 7th-8th 1, 9th-16th 0; +1 per finish (verified, BGIS 2024-2026)

title: Free Fire MAX
format: Custom-room battle royale, 12 squads per lobby, 3-6 matches (Bermuda/Purgatory/Kalahari); optional Champion Rush final
igIdHint: Numeric UID under your nickname on the profile (usually 9-10 digits)
rules: Free Fire MAX only (original Free Fire is blocked in India; Free Fire India not launched as of Oct 2026)
4 players + max 1 sub; phone only, no emulators
Captain uploads result screen within 15 min
Teaming/hacks = DQ + ban
Tiebreak: Booyahs > placement points > eliminations > last-match rank

title: Call of Duty: Mobile
format: 5v5 Multiplayer private match, Bo3 (Hardpoint / Search & Destroy / Control), single elimination, Bo5 final
igIdHint: Long number under your name in Player Profile (up to ~20 digits)
rules: 5 players + max 1 sub, swaps only between maps
Phone/tablet only, no emulators
Restricted weapons/perks list published on the event page
Winning captain uploads scoreboard within 15 min
DC in first 60 s = one restart; after that the map stands
scoring: Series = map wins; group tiebreak map diff > round diff > head-to-head; individual stats kills/deaths

title: Clash Royale
format: Qualifier via in-game Private Tournament (password), then Bo3 friendly-battle single-elim bracket, Bo5 final
igIdHint: Starts with #, e.g. #2PQ8RJ0L. Letter O is zero.
rules: Tournament Standard levels in friendly battles
Deck changes allowed between games
Winner uploads screenshot; admin may confirm via battle log
No-show 10 min after pairing = forfeit
scoring: Bo3 game wins; qualifier ranked by in-game tournament wins

title: Brawl Stars
format: 3v3 Friendly Game room, Bo3 across Gem Grab / Brawl Ball / Knockout, single or double elimination
igIdHint: Starts with #, found on your profile. Letter O is zero.
rules: 3 players + max 1 sub
Blind pick, no duplicate brawlers within a team
Map pool published before the event
Captain uploads result within 15 min

title: Pokemon UNITE
format: 5v5 custom battle, draft mode, Bo3 double elimination, Bo5 grand final (mirrors WCS 2026 India Qualifier)
igIdHint: 7-character letters+numbers code on your Trainer Info screen
rules: 5 players + max 1 sub
Draft mode, no duplicate Pokemon
Custom-lobby flow on mobile UNVERIFIED - test before launch
Captain uploads result screen within 15 min
scoring: Series = game wins; team score as tiebreak

title: eFootball
format: 1v1 Friend Match; groups of 4 (3/1/0) then two-leg knockout; 10-min matches
igIdHint: From User Information in game, e.g. ABCD-123-456-789 (format UNVERIFIED - also upload profile screenshot)
rules: Organiser fixes team rule per event (Authentic teams or Dream Team)
DC in first 5 in-game minutes at level score = replay
Winner uploads final-score screenshot within 15 min
Group tiebreak: points > goal difference > goals scored > head-to-head
scoring: Win 3, draw 1, loss 0 in groups; aggregate goals in knockout

title: Real Cricket 24
format: 1v1 Play with Friends, 2 overs per side in groups, 5 overs in knockouts
rules: Pro difficulty; same team allowed
Tie = Super Over (or 1-over replay)
Winner uploads scorecard screenshot within 15 min
Friend-match room flow UNVERIFIED - fallback title World Cricket Championship 3
scoring: Match wins; net run rate as tiebreak

title: Asphalt Legends Unite
format: Private room heats of 8 racers, 4 races per heat, top 2 advance to final
igIdHint: Your Asphalt Legends Unite racer name
rules: Car class cap announced per event for fairness
Host uploads each race result screenshot
Tiebreak: race wins > best finish in last race

title: Stumble Guys
format: Custom party heats (max 32), 5 games per heat, top 25% advance
rules: Teaming or griefing in custom party = DQ
Host uploads final-round screenshot each game
scoring: Per game: winner 10, 2nd 7, 3rd 5, reached final round 2

title: Ludo King
format: Private room 4-player tables, table winner advances, final table full game
rules: Classic or Quick mode fixed per event
No stakes, side bets or paid boosts (Online Gaming Act 2025)
Host uploads win screen

title: VALORANT
format: 5v5 custom game, Tournament Mode on, Mumbai server; Bo1 groups/Ro16, Bo3 semis and final, map veto
rules: 5 players + max 1 sub
Play on the registered Riot ID only - no smurfs
Vanguard needs TPM 2.0 + Secure Boot on Windows 11 - check before registering
Winning captain uploads scoreboard; match history checked
Standard first to 13, overtime win by 2
scoring: Series = map wins; tiebreak round differential; individual ACS/K/D

title: Counter-Strike 2
format: 5v5 private lobby, MR12, active-duty map pool with veto; Bo1 then Bo3
igIdHint: 17-digit number starting 7656119 (from your Steam profile URL or steamid.io)
rules: Run only if 8+ teams register (needs mid/high-spec PC)
5 players + max 1 sub
Demo (.dem) must be kept and provided on request
VAC/game bans on the account = ineligible
scoring: Series = map wins; tiebreak round differential

title: Chess (lichess.org)
format: lichess team Swiss, 7 rounds, 5+3 blitz (or Arena 60-90 min, 3+2), team-members only
igIdHint: Your lichess.org username (must join the IITM BS Esports lichess team)
rules: Must be an approved member of the lichess team
Results imported automatically from lichess API - no manual upload
Any lichess fair-play/TOS mark = DQ + platform ban
No engines, books or second device
scoring: lichess Swiss points (1/0.5/0), tiebreak Sonneborn-Berger then performance; Arena uses lichess arena points

title: skribbl.io
format: Private room heats (~12 players), 3-5 rounds, 80 s draw time, top 3 per room to final room
igIdHint: Use the same name as your platform profile
rules: No typing the answer in chat, no letters in drawings
One tab per person
Host uploads final scoreboard
scoring: In-game points; placement in room decides advance
